name: Fischl
notes: Both sources: 4pc Golden Troupe, Polar Star, Electro DMG goblet, CRIT circlet, Oz off-field. They differ on sands (KQM ATK% or EM for Aggravate, Game8 the same) and on the goblet (KQM adds Physical DMG for an on-field build); the off-field build (Electro goblet) is used. Talent order: KQM Skill > Burst for off-field and Skill = Normal Attack > Burst on-field; Game8's order did not parse (six entries), so KQM's off-field order is used. Goals ATK 2,000, CRIT Rate 60, CRIT DMG 120 are Game8's; ER 120 is the middle of both sources' double-Electro range (KQM 110-130 on-field, Game8 110-130). Partners are the elements of the reactions Oz triggers (Overloaded, Electro-Charged, Aggravate, Superconduct); no team list in the sources.
